theme_concept: Journey from Earth to outer space (alone -> part of a cohort)
tagline: Datang sebagai seseorang yang sendirian, dan pulang sebagai bagian dari sebuah angkatan.
art_direction: Aurora Dreamy - soft dreamy aurora gradients mixing purple, pink, blue, teal. Progressive gradient shift from Earth (warm) to deep space (cool). Playful, modern, round/orbit elements.

typography.import_instruction: Import Fredoka and Poppins fonts from Google Fonts in index.css

spacing_and_layout.mobile_first: Start with grid-cols-1, scale up to md:grid-cols-2 or lg:grid-cols-3. Images max-h-[80vh] on mobile.
spacing_and_layout.generous_spacing: Use p-8 to p-12 for bento boxes to give breathing room.

visual_enhancers.decorations: Use decorative SVG stars, small floating CSS/image planets, and dashed orbit rings positioned absolutely in the background.
visual_enhancers.buttons: Pill-shaped (rounded-full), aurora gradient background or crisp white, hover scale-105 transition.

kunci_orbit_gates.locked_state: Grayscale filter, backdrop-blur-md, bg-white/5, border border-white/10, centered lock icon, muted text opacity-50. Password input visible.
kunci_orbit_gates.unlocked_state: Full vibrant aurora gradient background (e.g., from-[#4361EE] to-[#4CC9F0]), border-[#4CC9F0]/50 glowing, crisp text, vibrant week content revealed.

gallery_grid.layout: Bento/masonry grid, mix of col-span-1, col-span-2, rounded-3xl overflow-hidden.
gallery_grid.hover: Group hover zoom effect on image, subtle overlay.

video_teaser.layout: 9:16 vertical aspect ratio container, max-w-sm mx-auto, surrounded by glowing orbit rings.

motion.hero_reveal: Masked line-by-line text reveal using framer-motion (initial { y: '100%', opacity: 0 }).
motion.parallax: Use framer-motion useScroll for subtle parallax on background planets/stars.
motion.marquee: Slow editorial marquee for tagline using framer-motion.

UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Do not use transparent backgrounds for dropdowns, overlays, or navbars.
Add data-testid attributes to all interactive elements for robust automated testing.
DO NOT apply universal transitions (e.g., transition: all). Add specific transitions for interactive elements.
DO NOT center align the app container in App.css (.App { text-align: center; }).
Use modern pill-shaped or sharp buttons with hover animations.
Create depth through layered elements with z-index and glassmorphism (12-24px blur).
Avoid AI slop: no generic centered layouts, use 2-3x generous spacing, apply subtle noise/grain textures.
Prioritize optical alignment over geometric alignment.
